This '''pirate group''' operated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and did not discriminate between targets, choosing to attack [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] allied to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], as well as neutral starships. Among the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] were a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]], [[Krudar]], and a [[Guudrian]] known as [[Boom]]. Shortly prior to the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Imperial forces decimated the organization. Krudar and Boom managed to escape to Kal'Shebbol.<ref name="tdc" />
